PlayGuard can only read this setting: it belongs to System Settings, which only the HOME menu can open.

To change it: HOME menu › System Settings › System › Date and Time › Synchronise Clock via Internet.

When it is on, the console clock follows the network clock. Note: when the clock was moved, the console was seen to start today's play time over.

dev.pt_block_intro:
Guardar as definições atuais do temporizador de jogo como referência?

Depois, altere uma definição na aplicação Controlo Parental Nintendo Switch, deixe a consola sincronizar e volte aqui: o PlayGuard lista os valores que mudaram. É assim que se podem interpretar as definições que o PlayGuard ainda não mostra (hora de dormir, só alarme ou suspender o software).

dev.pt_log_note: Every 30 s while PlayGuard is open, one line of what the play timer reports (time left, time spent, 1459, the settings block) in logs/play_timer_log.csv, and one more right after each change PlayGuard makes, saying which. A clock that moved more than the time that went by is noted too. Leave PlayGuard open over midnight, or until the time is up, to see what the console does then. Sent with the diagnostic report.
